name: kuanntw-skills-hub
description: A routing index for reusable AI skills maintained by kuanntw.

skills.name: DOCX Template
skills.description: Company-style Word document generation from Markdown, plain text, or JSON inputs.
use_when: The task involves generating a Word document.
The task involves converting Markdown, plain text, or JSON into a formatted company-style DOCX file.
avoid_when: The task only needs a Markdown answer and no document artifact.
skills.routing_hint: Use this skill when the user asks for Word output, DOCX templates, or formal document generation.

skills.name: Human Tone Chinese
skills.description: Traditional Chinese rewriting guidance for making text sound more natural, human, and less AI-like while preserving meaning.
use_when: The user asks to rewrite Chinese text in a more natural or human tone.
The task involves zh-TW copywriting, editing, tone refinement, or reducing AI-like phrasing.
avoid_when: The task requires strict legal, medical, or financial wording where style changes could alter meaning.
skills.routing_hint: Use this skill before rewriting Traditional Chinese prose, marketing copy, social posts, or user-facing messages.

skills.name: Karpathy Guidelines
skills.description: Coding discipline guidelines focused on simple, surgical, verifiable, and non-over-engineered changes.
use_when: The task involves planning, implementing, or reviewing code changes.
The task benefits from avoiding unnecessary abstraction, hidden assumptions, or broad rewrites.
avoid_when: The task is purely visual design or prose editing with no engineering decision.
skills.routing_hint: Use as a supporting skill for engineering tasks, especially when scope control and verification matter.

skills.name: Laravel Vibe Skills Kit
skills.description: A Laravel development skills kit covering project framing, architecture, APIs, Livewire, multilingual strategy, testing, release, and AI collaboration.
use_when: The task involves implementing, reviewing, or planning a Laravel application feature.
The task involves Laravel APIs, Livewire components, forms, tables, multilingual strategy, tests, releases, or observability.
avoid_when: The task is unrelated to Laravel or PHP application development.
skills.routing_hint: Use this kit for Laravel work, then choose the most specific subskill from SKILLS_INDEX.md.

skills.name: Logo Skills
skills.description: Logo design and brand identity delivery workflow for creating, reviewing, and packaging logo work.
use_when: The task involves creating, reviewing, refining, or packaging logo designs.
The task involves brand identity deliverables, visual identity systems, or logo handoff standards.
avoid_when: The task only needs general copy editing or unrelated code changes.
skills.routing_hint: Use this skill for logo or brand identity work before producing design directions, review checklists, or delivery packages.

skills.name: Playwright Read-Only Skills
skills.description: A Playwright read-only regression testing template and skill set for safe browser checks without destructive actions.
use_when: The task involves writing or running safe browser regression tests.
The task requires read-only Playwright checks, screenshots, UI verification, or non-destructive QA automation.
avoid_when: The requested test needs destructive writes unless explicitly approved and isolated.
skills.routing_hint: Use this kit for browser-based verification, especially when tests must avoid mutations.

skills.name: Skills Package Specification
skills.description: Reference specification for portable AI skill packages, metadata, layout, registry behavior, and progressive disclosure.
use_when: The task involves designing, validating, or discussing the structure of AI skills.
The task involves skill metadata, package layout, registry behavior, or compatibility with skill-reading agents.
avoid_when: The task requires using a concrete skill rather than discussing skill package design.
skills.routing_hint: Use this as a reference when changing hub structure, skill metadata, or package conventions.

skills.name: UI/UX Web Guidelines
skills.description: Web UI/UX guidance for layout, responsive design, accessibility, forms, helper text, and visual hierarchy.
use_when: The task involves designing or reviewing web interfaces.
The task involves responsive layouts, forms, information hierarchy, accessibility, or user-facing microcopy.
avoid_when: The task is purely backend logic with no user-facing interface impact.
skills.routing_hint: Use this skill before making or reviewing user-facing web UI changes.

skills.name: Vibe Coding Skills
skills.description: A structured AI-assisted development framework covering context, atomic tasks, memory, patterns, and collaboration workflows.
use_when: The task involves structuring AI-assisted development work.
The task involves planning context, task decomposition, project memory, or repeatable coding workflows.
avoid_when: The task requires a narrower concrete skill such as Laravel, Playwright, or document generation.
skills.routing_hint: Use this as a supporting framework when shaping larger AI-assisted coding workflows or project conventions.
